thread:
Olivia (Eng Manager): Heads-up—performance kickoff in 3 days. Can we get a tiny 1-page self-review + manager note I can paste into Slack threads or 1:1 agendas? Keep it scannable.
Sam (People Ops): Yup. Made a snackable version: 4 short self-review prompts (2 lines each max) + a 4-line manager note template + copyable "evidence" examples.
Sam (People Ops): ```IC self-review (5-10m)
1) Impact snapshot: one-sentence summary of top contribution and metric (e.g., "Led X, reduced lat by 40ms").
2) Tradeoffs & context: one sentence about tradeoffs or constraints.
3) Blockers removed: list 1 blocker you removed or still need help with.
4) Development ask: one skill/area you want to grow next cycle and a concrete step.

Manager note (copyable, ~3 lines)
- One-line summary: rating + 1-sentence rationale.
- Two quick examples: bullet the behavior + the result (metric or outcome).
- Next step: one concrete development action and owner.
- Calibration flag: yes/no (include link if "yes").

Evidence bank (paste examples)
- "Deployed feature X, increased successful requests by 12% in Q."
- "Reduced incident MTTD by creating new alerting and runbook."
- "Pair-programmed on design and upskilled two engineers on the module."
```
Priya (Manager, ML): This is great. Could we add a line for "cross-team impact"? My ICs often miss that.
Sam (People Ops): Added—swap "Blockers removed" to "Blockers & cross-team impact" and ask them to note collaborators. Short is key.
Andre (Dir, People Ops): Quick process note: submit manager notes to the calibration form by 1751010000. If you mark "exceeds" include two short examples. We'll run calibration reviews the following week.
Olivia (Eng Manager): Nice. Any suggestion for rating language I can copy into thread?
Sam (People Ops): Use this three-point snippet: "Exceeds: regularly drives outcomes beyond scope and mentors others. Meets: reliably delivers owned outcomes with growing autonomy. Needs support: inconsistent delivery; recommended development plan." Paste as-is.
eng-bot: Reminder: Performance kickoff doc is at https://intranet.redwood/perf-kickoff — templates in the "People Ops" folder.
Olivia (Eng Manager): Perfect, Ill post the template to my team channel and link the form. Thanks! :sparkles:
